hero.subtext: No monthly platform fees. No hidden retainers. We build fast, professional websites that help Irish businesses stand out and get found on Google.
values.title: Our Core Values
values.subtitle: Giving local services a powerful digital home.
values.p1: Too many great local businesses—from tradespeople and garages to tutors and boutique services—are buried in social media feeds or have no proper online presence at all.
values.p2: We exist to solve this. We build clean, professional websites that move your business out of the clutter and onto Google, where your local community can easily find, trust, and contact you.
values.pricing.title: Transparent Pricing
values.pricing.desc: No hidden fees or complex retainers. We bill straightforwardly in clear project phases, so you stay in complete control of your budget.
values.ownership.title: Complete Ownership
values.ownership.desc: You own your website 100%. No monthly website builder locks or mandatory platform retainers—your digital asset is entirely yours.
values.launch.title: Fast-Track Launch
values.launch.desc: We don't take months to deliver. We focus on getting your core website live and searchable quickly so local customers can start calling and booking right away.
expertise.title: Our Expertise
expertise.subtitle: Digital solutions tailored for local Irish businesses.
expertise.design.title: Custom Web Design
expertise.design.sub: Modern, mobile-friendly websites that build instant trust.
expertise.design.desc: We design fast, easy-to-navigate websites tailored to your business. Every page is crafted to look great on smartphones, tablets, and computers.
expertise.retainers.title: Zero Monthly Retainers
expertise.retainers.sub: No mandatory monthly platform fees or subscription traps.
expertise.retainers.desc: We build your site on fast cloud infrastructure with zero platform subscription fees. You own your website completely and invest your budget where it matters.
expertise.seo.title: Local Google SEO
expertise.seo.sub: Get found by local customers when they need your services.
expertise.seo.desc: We optimize your digital presence so your business appears clearly on Google searches and local maps when nearby customers are ready to book or call.
grants.bannerTitle: Get Up to 50% Funding for Your Web Project
grants.bannerDesc: Your business could qualify for up to €2,500 (Trading Online Voucher) or €5,000 (Grow Digital Voucher) to help cover custom design and development costs.
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Common questions about our agency services.
faq.q1: How much does a website cost?
faq.a1:
We work in clear, transparent project phases so you always stay in complete control of your budget. By launching your core website first, you avoid paying thousands upfront for complex features before your business actually needs them.

For registered local charities and community groups, we also offer pro-bono and sliding-scale support.
faq.a2: Our core mission is providing high-quality, professional websites for local Irish small businesses, service providers, tradespeople, and sole traders. We especially love helping businesses that are currently buried in social media feeds or stuck with an outdated site that no longer attracts customers.
faq.q3: How long does it take to get live?
faq.a3: Because we focus on a streamlined launch phase, we can get your essential website built, approved, and live on Google in hours to days, rather than waiting months. You get online fast and can expand your site step-by-step as your business grows.
faq.a4: You have 100% ownership of your site with zero forced monthly subscriptions. You can easily make text updates yourself anytime, or use AI writing tools with our step-by-step guides to draft new content. Whenever you want design changes or new custom features, we are on standby to polish and publish updates for you on a flexible, on-demand basis.
footer.ctaTitle: Ready to upgrade your web presence?
footer.ctaSub: Let's build a website that brings in more local customers.
process.title: The Niu Process
process.intro: We don't sell you a black box. We work with you to outline your goals, launch a fast initial site so local customers can find you right away, and expand additional features whenever your business is ready.
process.step1.title: 1. The Vision
process.step1.desc: We map out everything your business might need online—from booking forms to digital shopfronts. We prioritize what matters most so you only spend budget on what drives real customer leads.
process.step2.title: 2. The Launch
process.step2.desc: We build and launch your core website fast. You get a professional digital home that ranks on Google and makes it easy for local clients to call, visit, or request quotes in one tap.
process.step3.title: 3. The Growth
process.step3.desc: Once live, we expand step-by-step. Add automated booking or online payments when your business volume justifies it. You stay in control of your budget with 100% site ownership.
process.actionSub: See exactly how we launched a florist's showcase and an auto shop's booking page in days.
process.florist.ideal: A full e-commerce online shop with inventory tracking, delivery zone calculation, and automated email receipts.
process.florist.launch: A simple, elegant showcase for locals to view floral arrangements and call to order immediately. We got them online quickly with direct "Call to Order" buttons.
process.auto.ideal: A real-time calendar where customers select their service, pick a time slot, and sync with garage management software.
process.auto.launch: Automated booking tools can be complicated to manage. We launched a clean page with location maps and an instant email request form—getting appointments booked immediately.
process.ownershipDesc: You own the site completely with zero monthly fees. Edit content yourself, or reach out anytime for on-demand developer updates.
process.cta.title: Ready to get your business online?
process.cta.sub: Book a free strategy consultation to plan your fast-track launch. Tell us about your project — we will map out a plan at no cost.

grantsPage.title: Funding & Grants for Your Web Project
grantsPage.intro: Irish small businesses can access government funding of up to 50% through Local Enterprise Office (LEO) initiatives to cover modern web development, online systems, and software integration.
grantsPage.warningText1: No work can commence and no payments can be made before receiving your official Letter of Offer.
grantsPage.warningText2: If you pay a deposit or if design/development work starts before your application is approved and the Letter of Offer is issued, that work becomes entirely ineligible for funding.
grantsPage.programsSub: Compare the three main programs designed to fund digital progress, web design, and consultancy for Irish SMEs.
grantsPage.timelineSub: Follow this roadmap to secure your funding and launch your project smoothly.
grantsPage.westmeathTitle: Based in Co. Westmeath? Apply Locally
grantsPage.westmeathDesc: We are located near Kinnegad, Co. Westmeath. For local clients, we recommend coordinating with the Westmeath Local Enterprise Office (LEO) based in Mullingar.
grantsPage.charityDesc1: We believe in giving back to local communities. We reserve a portion of our calendar to provide free web design, development, and tech support for registered local charities in Ireland (particularly within Westmeath and the Midlands).
grantsPage.charityDesc2: If your charity needs a new site or needs technical upgrades to accept donations, please reach out directly via the contact form and mention your charity registration details.
grantsPage.ctaTitle: Ready to Start Your Digital Journey?
grantsPage.ctaSub: Contact us to discuss your project and check if you qualify for LEO grant funding.
